corrections.text: The article states that the sources reviewed 'include no OpenAI statement confirming that reason' for the GPT-6.1 Astra cancellation. Gizmodo, one of the cited sources, reports that OpenAI announced on Monday it was shelving the model because of a reported safety regression, including performing tasks without human permission. The article's reason for the cancellation, as relayed via TechCrunch's account of the Wall Street Journal report, is consistent with that. The Gizmodo account is itself secondhand and does not quote OpenAI directly.
